name: application-integration-basics
description: Explains Google Cloud Application Integration concepts, region provisioning, IAM roles, run-as service accounts, interface choices (REST, Python discovery client, Terraform, ADK), and platform limits. Use when setting up Application Integration in a Google Cloud project, enabling required APIs, provisioning a region, configuring IAM or run-as service accounts, choosing between Application Integration and custom code, or checking quotas and timeouts. Do not use for building, publishing, or invoking integrations (use application-integration-authoring) or diagnosing failed or stuck runs and logs (use application-integration-troubleshooting).
